summary: Cameco filed a 6-K disclosing a US$1,000,000,000 equity distribution agreement (an at-the-market program) dated November 5, 2026, among the company and agents TD Securities, CIBC and Scotia Capital (Canadian and US entities), plus legal consents and a press release. Shares may be sold from time to time at the company's discretion via placement notices, under a Canadian prospectus and an effective SEC Form F-10 registration statement, with USD/CAD conversion at the Bank of Canada daily rate. This is a routine shelf takedown facility, not a special situation; watch dilution and any actual sales volumes.
